$comment: Flaky-test quarantine ledger (deletion ratchet — see AGENTS.md 'Flaky tests: quarantine on sight' and docs/testing.md 'Quarantine ledger and the deletion ratchet'). A test observed failing without a corresponding real bug is quarantined ON SIGHT: add an entry here AND a matching one-line `exclude` entry in that package's vitest config, in the same commit. Every entry needs a non-empty `reason` (link the failing run) and a `quarantinedAt` date — the entry expires 14 days later, at which point the test file is DELETED unless someone rescues it with evidence it catches real regressions plus a root-cause fix (never appeasement). scripts/check-quarantine-ledger.mjs mechanically verifies this ledger and concrete `exclude:` array entries stay in lockstep.

entries.reason: RUFU-072 run-time OOM: RUNNING this file inside engine-default drives superlinear RSS 64G->120G in ~90s and trips the operator watchdog; the machine was halted 4+ times by it before the watchdog. `vitest list` proves the file correctly maps to [engine-default] (single-file, 25 tests) so whole-workspace discovery is NOT the cause — it is a retained-object leak (NotificationService/scheduler/registry) in the execute path. Quarantined per deletion ratchet so RUFU-069's verification never re-halts the box; do NOT widen limits/retries (anti-appeasement). Requires a non-appeasement root-cause fix to rescue: https://github.com/Runfusion/Fusion (RUFU-072) — isolated reproduction: engine-scoped `vitest run src/notification/__tests__/task-wedge-notification.test.ts` under `--max-old-space-size=1900` + 95% watchdog trips the watchdog, not the heap cap.

Second sighting of the RUFU-128 first-sighting register entry (docs/solutions/test-failures/suite-only-flakes-observed-register.md, bin.test.ts): `bin command routing and fallbacks > launches dashboard when no args are provided` again hit the 15000ms per-test timeout on a loaded host. Local runs 2026-08-20 (UTC) on branch fusion/rufu-128, host load average 15.22: whole-file run 23.8s (1 failed / 76 passed) and single-test-isolated 15.39s (transform 10.59s, test phase 15.02s). The suite factory-mocks ../commands/dashboard.js (the only packages/cli file RUFU-128 touched), so no RUFU-128 code executes in this test; the same no-args dashboard-launch timeout signature appeared in the 2026-06-20 FN-6839 loaded-lane history. Quarantined on sight per the deletion ratchet (second sighting = no further discretion); NO timeout widening, retries, or assertion changes. Expires 2026-09-03; rescue requires a root-cause fix for the loaded-host wall time, not appeasement.
